fields.site: Riverbend High School, 2200 Mill River Rd
fields.headline: All Riverbend High School students are safe and are being moved to a reunification site
fields.situation: At 10:15 a.m. today Riverbend High School was evacuated after a threat was received by phone. Every student and staff member left the building and has been accounted for. No one was injured. Riverbend Police are searching the building and the campus is closed for the rest of the day.

reunificationSite.name: Riverbend Community Center, Main Gymnasium
reunificationSite.address: 1200 Lake Ave, Riverbend (enter from the north lot on Elm St)

steps: Go to the check-in tables at the gym entrance. Fill out one reunification card for each student you are picking up.
Staff will check your photo ID against your student's emergency contact list. Only listed adults can pick up a student.
Wait in the family area. A staff runner will bring your student to the release door. This can take an hour or more.
Sign your student out at the release door. Do not leave with your student until staff complete the card.
Students 18 and older may sign themselves out at the same tables.
bring: Government-issued photo ID (driver's license, state ID or passport)
Your student's full name, grade and teacher
Patience: please plan for a wait
doNot: Do not go to Riverbend High School. Mill River Rd is closed between Oak St and 22nd St.
Do not call or text your student to leave; students will only be released at the reunification site.
Do not call 911 for information. Use the family information line.
fields.transport: Parking at the community center is limited. Park at the Lakeshore Plaza lot (Lake Ave and 9th St); a free shuttle runs every 10 minutes. Students who ride the bus will be released only to an adult.
fields.languageNote: Todos los estudiantes están a salvo. Recoja a su estudiante en el Centro Comunitario de Riverbend, 1200 Lake Ave, a partir de las 12:30 p.m. Traiga una identificación con foto. No vaya a la escuela.

release.notes: Student was in the counseling area, walked over by runner. Mother asked about backpack left in B-214.
